emulator: RIPPCSX2 2.9.96-rippcsx2.2 (portable lab copy, its own settings and a new throwaway memory card)
display: Auto NTSC 4:3; native PNG 640x480; unmodified emulator screenshots (F8)
media: 128 MiB MBR/FAT32 USB image (PCSX2 USB mass storage) holding four placeholder VCD files and one placeholder Ember folder with made-up names. No game data, no cover art; the cover shown is POPSLoader's own MISSING COVER placeholder.
scope: Interface captures only. No game was launched. Not a real-PS2 test.
notes: 'Booted from: HOST' is how the emulator reports the ELF it loaded; on a PS2 this line names the real boot device.
